ICS 85.080.10CHD 15New Standard from Last Update.1. Scope1.1 This standard prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for writing and printing paper.1.2 This part covers Air mail/manifold, Cartridge drawing, Cartridge white, Duplicating absorbent and duplicating semi-absorbent, Poster machine glazed varieties of writing and printing papers.2.
